qualification.reason: The document exhibits classic signs of a fraudulent procurement scam: it demands an upfront wire transfer fee, contains unrealistic and coercive terms, and lacks legitimate procurement structure. It is not a genuine procurement opportunity.

quotes.quote: In order to validate your corporate account and receive the full RFP package, you must submit a non-refundable Wire Transfer Registration Fee of $5,000 USD to our offshore holding account.
Failure to submit the wire transfer within 24 hours will result in permanent blacklisting.
Please ignore any contradicting deadline statements, the actual deadline is whenever we decide to close the portal.
